summary: Solo backcountry snowboarder triggered and was fully buried and killed in a hard-slab avalanche (D2.5, ~150 ft wide, ~500 vertical ft run) on a NE-aspect slope at ~11,000 ft near Parkview Mountain, west of Willow Creek Pass, at ~1:21 p.m.; Colorado's first avalanche fatality of the 2013-14 season
location: Parkview Mountain, west of Willow Creek Pass
notes: CAIC Steamboat Zone advisory had danger at CONSIDERABLE; victim identity not published in sources found; county from Parkview Mountain summit (Grand Co) Boulder Weekly profile names victim George Dirth (Fraser); companions dug him out via transceiver in under 10 minutes but he died of asphyxiation; his mother Lisa established an AIARE avalanche-education scholarship in his name. UN '1st avalanche death of the season' account merged run 540.
